modules.title: 同一品牌标志怎样适应不同页面位置
Logo 变体怎样保持品牌识别

items.title: 横版和图形版服务不同空间
items.text: 桌面页头可以放横向 Logo，窄屏导航可能需要图形版或紧凑版；变体可以改变排列和颜色，但核心形状、比例和身份应保持可识别。

items.title: 背景和承载区域也要纳入验收
items.text: 浅色、深色和拥挤的导航宽度会影响对比度、裁切和可读性。验收应看 Logo 在真实页头中的结果，而不是只看单独图片。

modules.title: 它不等于 Header、Favicon 或 App Icon
modules.text: {c:logo} 是品牌身份本身；{c:header} 是承载页头内容的页面结构；{c:favicon} 和 {c:app-icon} 分别服务浏览器和操作系统的特定位置。Logo 变小不代表已经适配了这些系统图标。

lessonPractice.title: 窄屏上横向 Logo 挤占了导航按钮，应该怎样处理？

options.label: 使用已定义的紧凑或图形版 Logo，并在窄屏和深色背景分别验收
options.feedback: 对。Logo 可以有适配变体，保持品牌识别的同时给导航留下空间；不应直接删除品牌或改成工具栏图标。

options.label: 继续缩小横向文字版 Logo，直到它和导航挤在同一行
options.feedback: 尺寸变小但文字不可读时，品牌识别已经失败；应切换到合适的紧凑变体。

options.label: 用菜单图标完全替代 Logo，让用户从导航里猜品牌
options.feedback: 菜单图标表达展开导航的动作，不能替代品牌身份入口。

en.title: A horizontal Logo crowds the navigation on a narrow screen. What should you do?

options.label: Use the defined compact or symbol Logo and verify it separately on narrow and dark surfaces
options.feedback: Correct. Logo variants can adapt to space while preserving recognition; do not delete the brand or turn it into a toolbar icon.

options.label: Keep shrinking the horizontal wordmark until it fits beside the navigation
options.feedback: If the text becomes unreadable, brand recognition has already failed; switch to an appropriate compact variant.

options.label: Replace the Logo entirely with a menu icon and make people infer the brand from navigation
options.feedback: A menu icon communicates the action of opening navigation and cannot replace the brand identity entry.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请保持品牌核心形状，为桌面页头、移动导航和深色背景选择合适的 Logo 变体。检查 Logo 不挤占导航、文字或图形仍可识别，并分别截图验收；不要顺带修改 Favicon 或工具栏功能图标。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Preserve the brand's core shape and choose suitable Logo variants for the desktop header, mobile navigation, and dark backgrounds. Verify that the Logo does not crowd navigation and remains recognizable, using separate screenshots. Do not change the Favicon or toolbar action icons as a side effect.

learning.assumes: You have seen a brand mark in a website header and a narrow mobile navigation layout.
learning.outcome: You can choose a Logo variant for a background or width and distinguish the Logo's responsibility from the Header, Favicon, and App Icon.

modules.title: How one brand mark adapts to page contexts

items.title: Wide and symbol forms fit different spaces
items.text: A desktop header can use a horizontal Logo, while a narrow navigation may need a symbol or compact form. Arrangement and color can change, but the core shape, proportion, and identity should remain recognizable.

items.title: Include the background and host area in testing
items.text: Light, dark, and crowded navigation widths affect contrast, cropping, and legibility. Verify the Logo in the real header, not only as an isolated image.

modules.title: It is not a Header, Favicon, or App Icon
modules.text: {c:logo} is the brand identity itself; a {c:header} is the page structure that hosts a Logo, navigation, and actions; a {c:favicon} and {c:app-icon} serve specific browser and operating-system surfaces. Making a Logo smaller does not adapt it automatically for those system icons.

distinctions.label: Header
distinctions.text: {c:logo} is the brand mark; a {c:header} is the top page region that organizes the Logo, navigation, and action entries.

distinctions.label: Favicon
distinctions.text: {c:logo} identifies the brand in page content; a {c:favicon} identifies the site in browser tabs, bookmarks, and history.
